feedback: APPROVE. PRD accurately reflects current state of hello.py (1-line print) and test_hello.py (subprocess test) — verified via Read. Goals, 4 user stories with Given/When/Then ACs, 10 FRs, 6 NFRs, traceability matrix, and risks are all present and proportionate. Acceptance criteria are behavioral and human-verifiable (no brittle byte/hex contracts). Slightly verbose for a ~5-line refactor but contains no manufactured rigor. No blockers.

findings.message: NFR-5 phrase 'byte-for-byte' is anchored to FR-6's behavioral stdout check rather than a hand-computed byte schema, so it is acceptable as written.
PRD is comparatively detailed for a trivial refactor; acceptable because the detail is proportionate (behavioral) rather than fabricated structure.
